headline: Ratchet & Clank reaches 98.38% and adds more release targets
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 matched code rose from 97.91% to 98.38%, with 5,073 of 5,124 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. PAL v1.00, NTSC-J v1.02 and NTSC-U now sit alongside the primary target, sharing source where their code allows it.
highlights: #108 adds nine matches, including sound updates, drone behaviour, the rope-follow camera and nanotech drawing.
#109 classifies five original assembly routines, including memory-copy helpers.
#110 adds release targets and #111 supplies 12 more PAL v1.00 and 23 NTSC-J v1.02 functions.
The final progress commit lists 4,839 finished functions for PAL v1.00 and 4,974 for NTSC-J v1.02. Those are separate release counts.
